name: socratic-tutor-poc
description: A debugging tutor that answers with questions and hints instead of solutions.

enumDescriptions: Canned offline replies. No API key, no network. Use this to work on the UI and the guardrail.
Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint (Groq, Together, OpenRouter, vLLM, ...). Needs baseUrl, model and an API key.
Local Ollama server on http://localhost:11434/v1. Needs model, no API key.

socraticTutor.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the model endpoint, e.g. https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 — used by the openaiCompatible provider.

socraticTutor.model.description: Model identifier sent to the provider, e.g. qwen/qwen3.8-27b. Providers retire model ids often -- check the provider's current list if you get a 404.

enumDescriptions: A question and nothing else. The student finds the line themselves.
A question, plus the lines highlighted in the submitted code.
The bug named and a fix that can be applied to the editor. No Socratic method.
socraticTutor.defaultMode.description: Which mode a new session starts in. It can be changed at any time from the panel.

socraticTutor.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower means the tutor sticks more closely to the system prompt.

socraticTutor.guardrailEnabled.description: Block replies that contain a full solution and ask the model to rewrite them as a hint. Never applies in Direct answer mode, which exists to hand over the fix.

socraticTutor.typewriter.description: Reveal the tutor's reply progressively instead of all at once. Cosmetic only, capped at about a second, and ignored when the OS asks for reduced motion.
